description: How Studio 1947 built a cloud-native, offline-first dashboard that simplifies billing, inventory and compliance for a Mirik medical shop.

ogDescription: A cloud-native, offline-first dashboard that brings point-of-sale, inventory and compliance together for a rural medical shop.

sections.label: Overview
sections.heading: A cloud-native dashboard for a modern medical shop.
body: The aim of this project was to set up a smart dashboard for the "Radha Madhav" medical shop, to simplify its day-to-day operations and make inventory easier to maintain. The system's billing entries save to the database in under 100 milliseconds, and it's built to keep pace with counters that process over 60 line items per minute.
Since the dashboard went live, the client has reported a ₹4,80,000 rise in quarterly revenue and near-expiry write-offs falling to under 0.5% of total product costs.

sections.label: Introduction
sections.heading: Digital transformation for a Mirik pharmacy.
body: Radha Madhav is a medical shop in Mirik, Darjeeling, that wanted to modernize how it works. The client needed one complete system to simplify daily operations, make inventory management easier, and improve retail efficiency overall.

sections.label: The Objective
sections.heading: Transform the entire operational workflow.
body: Studio 1947 was brought in to develop a smart dashboard for the Radha Madhav medical shop. The main goal was a cloud-native system that would change how the whole pharmacy runs, from point-of-sale transactions to inventory management and compliance logging.

cards.title: Smart Dashboard Development
cards.body: We designed and built a management dashboard made for pharmacies. It brings point-of-sale transactions, distributor procurement, and automated compliance logging into one interface.

cards.title: Offline-First Architecture
cards.body: The platform is offline-first, so billing keeps working during network outages. That matters in rural areas where connectivity is patchy.

cards.title: Intelligent Inventory Management
cards.body: We built an automated First-Expiry-First-Out (FEFO) allocation engine to manage medicine lots smartly and cut waste from expired products.

cards.title: Advanced Features Integration
cards.body: The dashboard includes real-time stock-on-hand visibility mapped to specific display racks, optical character recognition (OCR) to read doctor prescriptions, and instant drug interaction alerts.

sections.heading: Real gains in daily operations.

sections.label: Client Impact
sections.heading: Through our partnership, Radha Madhav achieved:
list: Inventory synced in real time across all operations.
Better customer service through faster checkout.
Far fewer financial losses from expired medicines.

sections.label: Why Studio 1947?
sections.heading: Tailored solutions for real-world challenges.
body: Studio 1947 builds tailored digital tools for real-world business problems. Our work with Radha Madhav combined technical work with an understanding of how a local pharmacy actually runs, day to day.
